scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"

scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/shared run test && npm --prefix packages/catalogue run test && npm --prefix packages/portrayal run test && npm --prefix apps/api run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/shared run lint && npm --prefix packages/catalogue run lint && npm --prefix packages/portrayal run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
